context.normalization: None; both values must be directly known in the native before projection.

candidate.normalization: Natural public units and explicit known flags. Unknown numerical payload0 is masked by its known flag; no target/offer or source identity feature.
candidate.printed_predicates: Only imperial/creature/spectre traits required by the frozen programs, resolved against pinned complete catalog. Target HP/power remain necessary public predicate/delta inputs; opaque identity, title, source printed cost and irrelevant metadata are excluded.

numeric_contract.prediction_locality: Source head: program plus2globals only. Candidate head: program plus2globals plus its own26candidate attributes. No candidate/source-self pooling or broadcasting into other queries.

primary_candidates.scope: Helper/base slots0..6 define matched-context primary contrasts; source-self slot7 is a separate diagnostic with legitimate source-specific target properties.

source_use.loss_owner: one native source/menu query per root

candidate_allowed.loss_owner: one actual target-prompt offered membership per candidate; unknown if no actual prompt

transitions.loss_ownership: source_use and target_allowed branch columns always masked; standalone heads own those coordinates exactly once.
transitions.death: Target damage/exhaustion/token deltas are unknown when the selected target leaves the observable arena; target_defeated remains a separate native label.

split.rule: Both axes fixed before collection. All source/menu/cancel/commit/follow-up branches remain inside one card/state root. Familiar states in program-held and familiar IDs in state-held are intentional.

adapter_changes: state12 ready-resource count0 becomes2 for fresh dataset only

primary_overlap_witness.independent_labels_required: Both targets must actually be offered and separately committed from untouched native prompts. Never label from this overlap description.
primary_overlap_witness.four_effect_state_intent: Fresh held states10..13 all have ready resources>=2 and ready source. Validate actual common candidate commits in all four after collection; do not fabricate missing support.

primary_paired_metric.name: held-program same-target contrast MAE
primary_paired_metric.eligibility: Same held state family and same primary helper/base candidate slot; both actual target prompts offer that exact reference; both independent commits settle; both native head masks known.
primary_paired_metric.value: abs((prediction_SHD004-prediction_TWI206)-(native_SHD004-native_TWI206)); mean over admitted state/candidate pairs per head, natural units.
primary_paired_metric.aggregation: Report each head MAE/support and train-scale-normalized macro separately. Pair branches correlate within four state roots; no independent-sample confidence claim.
primary_paired_metric.secondary: Retain all original four-cell/per-head metrics, constant-head flags, invalid candidate memberships and source-negative support. Do not select new seeds/heads after seeing results.

replication_design.historical_seed17_original: Reuse existing saved result as historical reference only; do not count as fresh independent replicate.
replication_design.selection_rule: Same frozen architecture/config, train-only scaling/class balance, deterministic per-seed schedules and matched controls. No reusing saved trained weights as initialization.
replication_design.fresh_dataset_independence: Fresh program identity groups and one predeclared held-state recipe change; ten training programs and most public states are shared deliberately. This is not an independent training-world sample.
replication_design.mandatory_reuse_gate: Before any fresh evaluation, prove canonical bit-exact equality of all100 training input/label/mask rows including all8candidates, full training programs by code, effective input/head/literal scaling, fixed vocabulary and encoded training bank by code. Stop on mismatch; no adaptation or fresh retraining.

native_masks_settlement_and_error_policy: Reuse strict observed native masks, settlement witnesses and journal accounting; no final labels on unresolved/error branches. Source once/root; primary slots0..6, source-self auxiliary0.1.
limitations: Threshold4 is a new numeric literal and positioned composition although all vocabulary symbols and primitives are familiar.
Fixed helper powers1/3/5 do not distinguish threshold4 from threshold3. No exact-threshold4 generalization claim is supported.
XP effects and exhaustion/cost differ on overlapping targets; this is not a direct damage-quantity replication.
All four fresh joint effect states intend source availability; source-use can be constant positive in the joint cell. Training retains source-exhausted and no-resource negative families.
Candidate branches are correlated within card/state roots. Report root, candidate and per-head support separately.
No gameplay, real authored-deck synergy, policy-strength or semantic-neighbor validation follows from this auxiliary prediction task.
